attemptRules: Fresh/restart row pairs may share one disposable profile within a declared pair.
Both packaged-after-Cowork attempts run two synthetic real-DSH/WSL turns and restart.
The separate without-Cowork pair performs normal startup/close/restart without work.
Preserve every result, including diagnostic or application failures.
No automatic retry and no additional attempts merely to obtain a PASS.
Record frozen source and package hash for runtime attempts; mark unavailable timestamps explicitly.
Original uninstrumented package comparison, if performed, is limited to two extra target-scenario attempts and labeled separately.
supplementalControlledCoverage: Deterministic native spawn failure, timeout, signal, output bound, nonzero early exit and monotonic-clock tests.
Actual Windows fresh/repeated private-state ACL validation and synchronous pre-yield assertion.
Actual packaged fail-closed malformed-state startup and owned cleanup where supported.
Interrupted-startup or child cancellation evidence must state whether it uses a synthetic child or the real application.
rootCauseClosure: Requires a demonstrated failure mechanism and a correction supported by evidence; a passing campaign or Full CI alone is insufficient.
